candidate.blueprint_locator: Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies: evaluate appropriateness and accuracy of medication orders, identify contraindications and interactions, and safely administer medications.
candidate.blueprint_topic: Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies — medication interaction/contraindication and safe transition from ACE inhibitor to ARNI
candidate.educational_objective: When switching from an ACE inhibitor to sacubitril/valsartan, verify the required 36-hour washout interval to reduce the risk associated with concomitant exposure, particularly angioedema.

options.A: Verify that at least 36 hours have elapsed since the last ACE-inhibitor dose.
options.B: Administer Entresto with the final ACE-inhibitor dose so renin-angiotensin blockade is not interrupted.
options.C: Verify only that the client's heart rate is above 60/min because no washout interval is required.
options.D: Delay Entresto for 7 days after any ACE inhibitor, regardless of the timing specified in the prescription.

candidate.rationale: The current Entresto prescribing information contraindicates concomitant use with an ACE inhibitor and requires a 36-hour washout period when switching from an ACE inhibitor to Entresto because combined use increases the risk of angioedema. Therefore, the nurse should verify that at least 36 hours have elapsed. B creates prohibited concomitant exposure, C ignores the required washout, and D invents a longer universal interval not supported by the label.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Directly supports the exact 36-hour washout interval and the angioedema-related contraindication to concomitant ACE-inhibitor and Entresto use.
candidate.source_document_title: ENTRESTO (sacubitril and valsartan) — Official Prescribing Information
candidate.source_locator: Section 2.1, General Considerations: Entresto is contraindicated with concomitant ACE-inhibitor use; when switching from an ACE inhibitor to Entresto, allow a washout period of 36 hours. Section 4, Contraindications: do not administer within 36 hours of switching from or to an ACE inhibitor. Section 7.1, Dual Blockade of the Renin-Angiotensin-Aldosterone System: concomitant ACE-inhibitor use is contraindicated because of increased angioedema risk.
candidate.source_organization: National Library of Medicine / U.S. Food and Drug Administration labeling via DailyMed
candidate.stem: A provider discontinues an ACE inhibitor and plans to start sacubitril/valsartan (Entresto). Which nursing action is most important before the first Entresto dose?
